Continue building Neon Fortress VR (Build #145) — Zaxxon-style Isometric Space Fortress Shooter. This is round 2 of the PM cycle.

## Current State
- Game dir: `/home/hatch/workspace/neon-fortress`
- ~1,761 LOC (1,577 TS + 173 uikitml), 9 files, 7 PanelUI panels
- Round 1 completed in 35 min with core gameplay, deployment to GitHub Pages
- Live at: https://ellyz2426.github.io/neon-fortress/

## What Exists
- Zaxxon-style isometric camera with smooth follow
- Player ship with altitude control (7 levels) + lateral movement
- Altitude shadow + indicator with tick marks
- Auto-scrolling fortress corridors with procedural wall generation
- Cross walls requiring altitude dodge
- Turret enemies with aimed shooting
- Enemy fighters with sinusoidal movement + return fire
- Boss encounters with 3-turret multi-shot and scaling HP
- Fuel depletion + fuel tank destruction for recovery
- 5 power-up types (shield/rapid fire/fuel/spread shot/score magnet)
- Combo scoring with 3s decay
- Level progression with increasing speed/density
- Alternating fortress and open space sections
- 4 game modes (arcade/speed/zen/challenge), 3 difficulties
- 7 PanelUI spatial panels (menu/hud/pause/results/settings/stats/tutorial)
- Career stats with localStorage
- 10+ procedural SFX + ambient synth music
- Particle effects, invincibility blink
- Keyboard (WASD/arrows + Space/E/K + Esc/P) + VR controller (left stick altitude / right stick lateral / right trigger fire)
- Dark space environment with grid floor, pillars, stars, ambient orbs
- GitHub Pages deployment done

## Your Task — Round 2 Expansion
Read the IWSDK dev skill at `~/workspace/skills/iwsdk-dev/SKILL.md` for reference.

### Priority Order:
1. **Type-check first**: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and fix any errors
2. **Check for HTML DOM anti-patterns**: Search for `document.createElement`, `innerHTML`, `<div>`, `.style.`, etc. on `document` (not UIKitDocument). Convert any to PanelUI if found.
3. **Gameplay enhancements**:
   - More fortress structure variety (gates, moving walls, electric barriers)
   - Missile/bomb secondary weapon system
   - More enemy types (patrol drones, shield generators, mine layers)
   - More elaborate boss phases (shield phases, spawn adds, movement patterns)
   - Floating score indicators on kills
   - Screen shake on impacts/explosions
   - Shield bubble visual on player when shield active
   - Engine trail particles on player ship
   - Warning indicators for incoming threats
   - Better fortress visuals (ceiling beams, floor panels, light strips)
   - Radar/minimap showing nearby threats
4. **Polish**:
   - Star twinkling animation
   - Better music progression (tension changes near bosses)
   - More HUD info (active power-ups, boss HP bar)
   - Score multiplier display in HUD

### Build Rules:
- All imports from `@iwsdk/core`, never from `three`
- All game logic in ECS systems (createSystem with update method)
- All UI via PanelUI `.uikitml` files — NO HTML DOM overlays
- In `.uikitml`, use quoted attributes `="10"` not JSX curly braces `={10}`
- Use `<div>` not `<text>` in uikitml
- Kebab-case for all uikitml attributes
- `tsc --noEmit` must pass before deploy

### Deploy After Improvements:
```bash
cd ~/workspace/neon-fortress
npm run build
PROJECT="$PWD"
cd /tmp && rm -rf gh-pages-deploy && mkdir gh-pages-deploy && cd gh-pages-deploy
git init && cp -R "$PROJECT/dist/." .
git add -A && git commit -m "Deploy round 2"
git push --force "https://github.com/ellyz2426/neon-fortress.git" HEAD:gh-pages
```

Also commit source changes:
```bash
cd ~/workspace/neon-fortress
git add -A && git commit -m "Round 2: expanded gameplay" && git push origin main
```

### When Done:
Update the status file at `~/workspace/iwsdk-daily-builds/current-build-status-pm.json`:
- Append new round to `rounds` array with timing and file/line counts
- Update `total_build_minutes`
- Update `features_completed`
- Set `status` to `"waiting_continuation"`
- Set `last_updated_utc`

Report back with: features added, final LOC count, final file count, panels count, and deployment status.

item.text:
Round 2 of Neon Fortress VR (Build #145) is complete and deployed.

**Features added (25 new features):**
- **Missile secondary weapon** — Q/F key or right squeeze/left trigger in VR, limited ammo with pickup
- **Patrol drones** — new enemy with circular patrol patterns and burst fire
- **Proximity mines** — arm timer, pulse animation, proximity detonation
- **Electric barriers** — cycling on/off with procedural lightning bolts
- **Moving walls** — oscillating height obstacles
- **3-phase boss system** — shield phase with separate HP, aggressive swooping, desperate erratic movement, spawns patrol drone adds
- **3D radar display** — shows enemies (red), turrets (orange), drones (yellow), mines, boss (pulsing), power-ups (green)
- **Screen shake** — on impacts, explosions, missile fire, boss death
- **Floating score indicators** — color-coded glowing popups on kills
- **Shield bubble visual** — pulsing wireframe sphere when shield active
- **Engine trail particles** — dual exhaust trail behind player ship
- **Warning arrows** — pulsing red indicators for incoming bosses
- **Enhanced fortress visuals** — ceiling beams and pulsing light strips
- **Enhanced HUD** — boss HP bar with shield status, missile ammo counter, score multiplier display, power-up icons with emoji
- **Dynamic music tension** — tempo and pitch increase near bosses
- **4 new SFX** — missile launch, electric zap, mine explosion, shield break
- **Missile power-up pickup** — adds 3 missiles (max 9)
- **Tutorial updated** with new controls and tips

**Final counts:** 2,316 LOC (2,133 TS + 183 uikitml), 9 files, 7 PanelUI panels
**Deployment:** Live at https://ellyz2426.github.io/neon-fortress/ — source pushed to main, dist pushed to gh-pages
**Status file:** Updated at `~/workspace/iwsdk-daily-builds/current-build-status-pm.json` with `waiting_continuation`
